page_title: LIV 2-0 BRE | Liverpool v Brentford 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) has tested the patience of referee Stuart Attwell and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' The game has come to an end for Ryan Gravenberch. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
89' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
88' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
86' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) will replace Mohamed Salah.
82' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

82' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) received an accurate pass just outside the penalty area and produced a quick strike. It would have probably ended behind the goalkeeper, but one of the defenders managed to deflect it onto the post. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
79' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
77' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
73' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Yoane Wissa will be replaced by Kevin Schade (Brentford).
73' Substitution. Vitaly Janelt will be replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
72' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Trent Alexander-Arnold.
72' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Diogo Jota and he is replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luis Diaz walks off the pitch to be replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
71' 2 - 0 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
70' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
66' Here is a change. Mathias Jensen is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Fabio Carvalho (Brentford).
66' That will be all from Keane Lewis-Potter who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
66' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
66' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
66' Liverpool will take a corner kick.

65' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball from hitting the net. What a save!
62' Mark Flekken pulls off a fine save! Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
61' Liverpool fail to score from a corner as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaps to collect the ball.

60' A pass lands at the feet of Diogo Jota (Liverpool) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.
59' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

56' What a save from Alisson! Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
55' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
55' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
52' Brentford work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
52' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
50' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Luis Diaz (Liverpool) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Liverpool.

48' What a save from Mark Flekken! Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
43' A snap shot by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Alisson produces a good save to thwart him.
42' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

41' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
40' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
38' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) for his blatant foul.
36' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
36' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Corner kick. Brentford will have an opportunity.

33' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
32' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) whips the ball in from the free kick, but it goes well out of play.
30' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stuart Attwell had an easy-decision to make.
29' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!

27' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. Liverpool win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
24' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) attempts to find Andrew Robertson, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
21' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
20' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken reads it well and gathers the ball.
19' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.

19' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
18' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Diogo Jota tees up Luis Diaz (Liverpool) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Mark Flekken.
13' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
10' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
7' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
3' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sprays a pass out to Diogo Jota, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
1' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) picks up a yellow card.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell is introduced as the referee for today's match.
